name: Spitescale Cove
summary: Spitescale Cove is the northernmost islet of the Echo Isles, situated just off the coast of Durotar. Currently claimed by hostile Spitescale naga, it serves as a dangerous beachhead directly threatening the nearby Darkspear troll settlements.

sections.title: A Serpent Enclave
sections.body: While the Darkspear trolls struggle to reclaim their southern holdings from the traitor witch doctor Zalazane, the northern reaches of the Echo Isles harbor another deadly threat. Spitescale Cove has been thoroughly occupied by the serpentine Spitescale naga. Led by the sea witch Zar'jira, these aquatic invaders have established an entrenched camp centered around a natural sea cave. For the young Horde defenders in Durotar, this cove represents an active staging ground aimed at wiping out the beleaguered Darkspear exile community.

faq.answer: Spitescale Cove comprises the northernmost isle of the Echo Isles archipelago, located in the Great Sea off the southeastern coast of Durotar.

aliases: what mobs are in spitescale cove
faq.answer: The cove is occupied by hostile Spitescale naga, led by the sea witch Zar'jira. They have fortified the isle and its natural cave as a base of operations.

faq.q: Why are the naga attacking the Darkspear tribe here?
aliases: why are naga at echo isles
faq.answer: The naga have long harbored deep hatred for the Darkspear trolls, tracing back to the Darkspear islands in the South Seas where the sea witch Zar'jira first sought their destruction. The naga at Spitescale Cove intend to finish what they started by eradicating the trolls in their new home.
No. Zalazane commands the main central and southern islands of the Echo Isles with his hexed thralls. The naga operate entirely independently under Sea Witch Zar'jira on this separate northern islet.

angles.text: For the Darkspear, Spitescale Cove is a bitter reminder of the Sea Witch Zar'jira, who hunted your people across the seas and now seeks to destroy your refuge in Durotar.
The naga encamped at the mouth of the Southfury River pose an immediate raiding threat to Sen'jin Village and Durotar's fragile southern border.
